frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Feel the vibrations, Elder Maoi. Together, we will overcome the Grand Composer's tyranny.

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: The rhythm of Harmonius prevails! Let us drown out the silence with our music!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Yes! Feel the power of groove, Grand Composer! Your reign ends now!

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: The chiptune beats of Harmonius shall prevail!!!!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: We did it! The Grand Composer's evil music is repelled!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: I can feel the Mojo inside me growing...

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: Traveller, you have brought light to our world once more. We are forever grateful.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Elder Maoi. But my ship... it's broken. I need parts to repair it if I am to continue my journey.

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: Ah, I understand. Fear not, for nearby lies Electronova, a planet renowned for its technological prowess. Their expertise will surely aid you in repairing your vessel.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Electronova... How can we reach there?

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: Allow us to assist you, traveller. We shall guide you to the shores where the Great Wave awaits. It is a cosmic vessel that sails the celestial currents, capable of transporting you swiftly to Electronova.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Elder Maoi. Your kindness and guidance are greatly appreciated.

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: It is our pleasure, traveller. Take with you the Celestial Amp, it may prove helpful in future battles.

frames.heading: Celestial Amp
frames.body: I don't know what this is for, but Elder Maoi thinks it might be helpful...

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Farewell, for now. We shall return, bringing with us the echoes of our shared triumph.
